name: Shield
description: An invisible barrier of magical force appears and protects you. Until the start of your next turn, you have a +5 bonus to AC, including against the triggering attack, and you take no damage from magic missile.
effect: When an attack would hit you, an invisible barrier springs up: +5 AC until the start of your next turn, including against that attack.
notes: A reaction: keep it prepared and it casts itself when an attack would hit you and +5 AC would make it miss, so it never spends mana on a hit it can't stop. Once a round.
+5 AC lasts until the start of your next turn.
A staff provides the mana-crystals free each cast.
